layer_3_action.subject: Vibrant, sun-drenched tropical lagoon and salt flats
features: Bright turquoise shallow waters over white carbonate sand
Low-lying limestone reefs breaking the gentle surf
Stunted, salt-tolerant Araucarian conifers on the shoreline
Exposed white salt-crusts shimmering in the intense heat
Clumps of tough, succulent-like Bennettitales near the beach
layer_3_action.action: A high-contrast coastal scene with intense tropical light. The landscape is arid and saline at the water's edge, transitioning to scrubby, prehistoric evergreens. No grass.

visuals.ground: Blindingly white carbonate sand and light-colored limestone nodules. Cracked salt-pans in dried depressions. No grass.
visuals.water: Crystal-clear turquoise water with visible limestone structures beneath the surface.
visuals.sky: Intense, saturated blue with high-altitude cirrus clouds and shimmering heat haze.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Hardened calcarenite, fine white sand, and salt crystals.

negative_prompt: grass, jungle, dark mud, rainforest, river, pine trees, gloom, rainy
